settlement_source: State government of Nevada (usa.gov listing; actual: state inauguration record); accelerated path uses 8 Designated Media Sources (NYT, AP, DDHQ, CNN, Fox, NBC, CBS, ABC)
settlement_variable: Party of the person sworn in as Nevada governor pursuant to the 2026 election; replacement's party if vacancy before seating
tie_handling: unknown (not stated in contract terms; resolution follows whoever is sworn in)
trading_close_vs_settlement: Listed close/expiration_time 2027-11-03T15:00Z is a placeholder maximum. Contract can close early (can_close_early=1): accelerated determination when >=4 of 8 Designated Media Sources declare a winner and none contradict; otherwise expiration = sooner of first 10:00 AM ET after swearing-in or one year after the popular vote. Settlement no later than the day after expiration unless under review. API settlement_timer_seconds=14.
early_close_or_void_clauses: Accelerated determination on 4/8 media consensus with no contradictory call (incl. 'unambiguous statement in a news article' counts; affiliate calls can stand for network; national desk supersedes). Exchange may replace a media source at sole discretion. Kalshi may start Market Outcome Review (Rule 6.3(c)/7.1) at sole discretion before settlement, delaying payout. Party switch between election and swearing-in: resolves on party on election day. Revisions after expiration ignored.
title_vs_rules_divergences: Title says 'win the race/governorship' but rules resolve on swearing-in/inauguration, with accelerated early resolution by media calls; formal basis differs from the call-based practical resolution.
Source Agency lists a generic body (usa.gov state-governments directory) that publishes no real-time result; real determinant in practice is media consensus.
Expiration date shown (2027-11-03) is not the real settlement date.
Markets name candidates (Lombardo/Ford) in yes_sub_title but rules resolve on party of whoever is inaugurated.

public_feeds_for_settlement_variable.name: AP Elections API / apnews.com race calls

toxicity_flags: Settlement is event-driven by public media calls; counts and calls are public and widely watched -> informed flow/latency race at call time.
Accelerated early close can end trading abruptly once 4/8 sources call; stale quotes at close are adverse-selection risk.
Discretionary Market Outcome Review and media-source substitution at Exchange's sole discretion.
Insider-restriction list (vote tallers, campaign staff, decision-desk employees) implies exchange recognizes informational asymmetry near counts.
Prices (Nevada) are not yet at 0/1 despite election day Nov 3 2026 having passed: outcome likely uncalled/contested; resolution timing uncertain.
notes: Incumbent R governor Lombardo; rules key on 2026 election. Card derived from Kalshi contract_terms PDF GOVPARTY and sample market rules; series-level data from universe.db as of 2026-11-09.
